title: 95% of disbursement moved within 72 h
explanation: 1 outgoing transfer(s) totalling ₹6,20,000 left the credited account within 72 hours of a ₹6,50,000 disbursement.
totalBasis: Sum of outgoing transfers from the credited account inside the window (repayments excluded).
benign: Payment to a supplier or dealer for the stated purpose (e.g. equipment purchase) is often immediate.
Pre-arranged vendor payments may be made as soon as funds arrive.
steps: Compare payees with the quotation / pro forma invoice on file.
Request the purchase invoice or delivery proof.
Confirm the asset or inventory physically at site visit.

title: Payment to linked entity: Bhosale Infra Developers Pvt Ltd
explanation: ₹5,00,000 was paid to Bhosale Infra Developers Pvt Ltd, which is connected to the borrower via 2 recorded relationship(s).
threshold: Any outflow to an entity within two relationship hops
totalBasis: Sum of outflows from the credited account to accounts held by the linked entity.
benign: Related businesses may legitimately trade with each other at market terms.
A shared director or family relationship does not by itself indicate misuse.
steps: Obtain invoices / contracts for the payment and check pricing against market.
Confirm goods or services were delivered for the stated purpose.
Record the relationship disclosure in the borrower file.

title: Funds returned to borrower account after 3 hops
explanation: ₹4,00,000 left the borrower account and ₹3,50,000 (88%) came back within 2.8 days through 2 intermediate party(ies).
totalBasis: Amount of the first outgoing transfer in the observed sequence; the return leg is shown separately.
benign: A supplier refund or cancelled order could return funds.
An owner's capital introduction may coincidentally follow a supplier payment.
steps: Request the supply contract and refund/cancellation documentation.
Verify whether the intermediate party delivered any goods or services.
Escalate to the investigations team if no commercial explanation is documented.

title: 3 cash withdrawals just below ₹1,00,000
explanation: 3 cash withdrawals between ₹90,000 and ₹1,00,000 totalling ₹2,90,500 occurred within 7 days.
totalBasis: Sum of qualifying cash withdrawals inside the window.
benign: Rural labour and contractor payments are frequently made in cash.
ATM / counter limits can force multiple withdrawals.
steps: Ask the borrower for the purpose of the cash withdrawals and supporting vouchers.
Check the stated purpose (e.g. installation work) against contractor receipts.

title: Navnath Enterprises received funds from 2 monitored loans
explanation: Navnath Enterprises received 2 payment(s) of at least ₹1,00,000 from accounts linked to loans L-2026-0110, L-2026-0111 within 12 days.
totalBasis: Sum of qualifying payments to the counterparty across all monitored loans.
benign: The counterparty may be a common regional supplier used by many borrowers.
Seasonal purchasing often concentrates on a few dealers.
steps: Check whether the counterparty is an established supplier for this loan purpose.
Compare invoices across the loans for duplicate invoice numbers or identical amounts.
